settings.title: A Stiff Neck Today Can Turn Into Costly Cervical Pain Tomorrow.

settings.text: Hours of awkward sleeping while traveling don’t just leave you uncomfortable — they can lead to chronic neck strain, cervical pain, and expensive treatments. Why risk long-term damage (and hospital bills) just for a short nap on the go?

settings.title: New Moms Deserve Rest Too — But Sleepless Nights Say Otherwise.

settings.text: Endless late-night feeds leave you sitting upright for hours, your neck and shoulders aching while your baby finally drifts to sleep. Over time, this strain turns into constant fatigue, stiff neck pain, and even cervical issues, making motherhood even harder than it already is. Moms sacrifice their comfort every night — but it shouldn’t come at the cost of their health.

settings.heading: Is it suitable for long flights and overnight journeys?
settings.row_content: Yes. The ergonomic design provides continuous neck and head support, reducing stiffness and fatigue even on 8–10 hour flights or road trips. Many frequent flyers use it as their go-to comfort companion.

settings.heading: How do I inflate and deflate the pillow?
settings.row_content: The pillow features a discreet air valve. Simply press to inflate within seconds, and release the valve for instant deflation. No pumps or extra effort required — designed for quick use during travel.

settings.heading: Is the cover washable and easy to maintain?
settings.row_content: Absolutely. The premium ice silk cover is removable, breathable, and machine-washable. It stays fresh and hygienic even after frequent use, making it perfect for both travel and daily relaxation.

settings.heading: Is it compact and easy to carry?
settings.row_content: Yes. When deflated, it folds neatly into a small pouch that fits easily into handbags, backpacks, or carry-on luggage — ensuring you enjoy luxury comfort without bulk.

settings.heading: Will it fit all neck sizes?
settings.row_content: The pillow is designed with an adaptive U-shape that suits most neck sizes comfortably. Its ergonomic contour ensures a snug, supportive fit for men and women alike.

settings.heading: Is it durable enough for frequent use?
settings.row_content: Yes. Crafted with premium-quality materials, it’s built to withstand regular travel and long-term use without losing shape, firmness, or comfort.

settings.heading: Do you offer Cash on Delivery?
settings.row_content: Yes. We provide Cash on Delivery across India for your convenience. You can pay only after your product is delivered safely to your doorstep.
